title: [BUG] Claude Code crashed when I tried to use it on a Windows environment
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.51 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Windows 11
- Terminal: PowerShell 7.5.2

## Bug Description
<!-- A clear and concise description of the bug -->

## Steps to Reproduce
```powershell
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
mkdir your-awesome-project
cd your-awesome-project
claude
```

It starts by asking you to choose a theme, then proceeds to authenticate your subscription, and finally asks you whether to trust the folder. Press Enter to continue. Here, the program crashed.
